mentions.name: Meal tracking app (iOS/SwiftUI)
mentions.description: An iOS meal tracking app built with SwiftUI that helps users understand eating patterns by logging mood, hunger levels, and where meals are eaten. Built to learn Swift and being shipped to the App Store.
